autoDismiss.description: Dismisses the Callout on a timer. A number sets the delay in milliseconds, and true uses 8000. Leave it unset to keep the Callout visible until it is dismissed another way.

body.description: The Callout body, shown beneath the title.

hideBody.description: If set to true, hides the Callout body and centers the icon against the remaining content.

hideTitle.description: If set to true, hides the Callout title.

icon.description:
Override the icon displayed before the children.
Unless provided, the icon is mapped to the value of the `severity` prop.
Set to `false` to remove the `icon`.

intent.description: Required. Sets both the color of the component and the icon it defaults to.

sdsStyle.description: Defines the style of the Callout: - "persistent": Cannot be closed. - "expandable": Includes a chevron icon that toggles the children in and out of view. - "dismissible": Includes an “x” icon for manual dismissal.
